description: Write a new version of one of your Besidka artifacts, from either `edits` (find-and-replace pairs; each old_string must occur exactly once, otherwise the call fails naming the edit and nothing is saved) or the full `content`, never both; `title` is optional. Older versions are kept, up to 50 per artifact, and a change computed from an older version than the latest is refused. Public links that follow the latest version show the new one at once. Requires signing in (artifacts:write).

content.description: The full new content, up to 200000 characters. Send this or edits, not both

edits.description: Exact find-and-replace pairs applied in order to the latest version; each old_string must occur exactly once. Send this or content, not both

id.description: Artifact id from list_artifacts or create_artifact

title.description: A new title for the artifact

name: update_artifact
title: Update an artifact
